paragraphs.source_en: *‘‘What if it doesn’t work?’’* Almost 100 percent of the customers you will deal with worry about their reputations and their jobs. If they approve of a sale and then the product or service does not perform as promised, they will look foolish and might even get fired! Everyone has gotten stuck with a lemon at one time or another. Buyer’s remorse never really goes away and anytime we make a big purchase we worry about the possibility that our money will go to waste.
